artifact.name: nifty-prediction-reports-39699761966
artifact.note: Contains raw prediction rows in the GitHub Actions artifact; this repository summary contains only aggregate metrics.

holdout.split: Chronological first 80 percent development / final 20 percent holdout
holdout.selection: Validation CV loss only; holdout was not used to choose a winner
holdout.metadata_note: The original technical run metadata incorrectly said 8 sequence epochs; code set epochs=3 before fitting. The metadata discrepancy is fixed for future runs.

selected_global_volatility_h1.target: Absolute next-session log return (one-session volatility proxy)
selected_global_volatility_h1.interpretation: Statistically strong one-session volatility-proxy forecast result in this single chronological holdout; requires independent-period replication and is not evidence of a trading edge.

selected_technical_volatility_expansion_.interpretation: Exploratory; does not meet 0.05 after correction across 33 selected tests.

conclusion.return_prediction: No robust selected-model improvement over zero-return benchmark.
conclusion.direction_prediction: No robust selected-model edge after multiplicity correction.
conclusion.level_prediction: Selected global models are significantly worse than persistence at all three horizons after correction.
conclusion.volatility_prediction: One-session volatility-proxy QLIKE result survives Holm correction across all 299 OOS model comparisons; treat as a replication candidate only.
conclusion.options_strategy: Not evaluated. Fixed-contract identity and executable-price gates remain blocked; no P&L or trading recommendation.

limitations: One chronological holdout only; no independent-period replication.
NSE official endpoint returned no recognized rows.
USD/INR, gold and WTI were rejected by current OHLC validation and were excluded.
Weekend-dated rows are preserved and flagged for exchange-calendar review.
Options chains, FII/DII, PCR, breadth, timestamped news and point-in-time corporate actions were not acquired and validated.
The volatility target is a daily-return-based proxy, not intraday realized volatility.
No brokerage, spread, slippage, margin or execution simulation was performed because this was prediction-only research.
